# trust-no-readme

> Reproducible, commit-pinned code-vs-claims audits of popular open-source projects, mechanically verified against upstream Git commits in CI.

## Machine-Readable Index & Schemas
- [Catalog JSON](data/catalog.json): Schema v3 aggregate of all tracked projects, current vs. historical peak ratings (`honesty`, `risk`, `history`), `impact_summary`, `verified_fixes`, per-project `remediation` posture/items, and report paths.
- [Frontmatter Schema](data/schema/audit-frontmatter.schema.json): JSON Schema for immutable canonical audit snapshots (`YYYY-MM-DD-<8char-sha>.md`).
- [Tracking Schema](data/schema/tracking.schema.json): JSON Schema for mutable per-project upstream issue & remediation ledgers (`audits/<forge>/<owner>/<repo>/tracking.json`).

## Agent & Contributor Protocol
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions for AI agents (querying audits/impact, submitting new audit PRs, fix re-audits, maintainer responses, structured Issues, and syncing/verifying upstream fixes).
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contributor guide and CI gates.
- [METHODOLOGY.md](METHODOLOGY.md): Independent Contract Alignment (`H0–H4`), Boundary Risk (`R0–R4`), Upstream Remediation & Responsiveness (Axis C), and Evidence Tiers (`E0–E3+D`).
- [DISCLOSURE.md](DISCLOSURE.md): Coordinated vulnerability disclosure, upstream issue filing etiquette, fix verification gates, and maintainer right of reply.

## Submission Templates
- [New Audit Snapshot Template](templates/audit-snapshot.md)
- [Fix Re-Audit Snapshot Template](templates/reaudit-snapshot.md)
- [Maintainer Response Template](templates/maintainer-response.md)
- [Upstream Engineering Issue Template](templates/upstream-issue.md)
- [Pull Request Template](.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)

## Local CLI Commands (Stdlib-Only Python 3.11+)
- Scaffold snapshot: `python3 tools/new_audit.py --repo owner/name --sha <40-hex> --category <cat>`
- Sync observed upstream issue states: `python3 tools/sync_issues.py --format json` (add `--write` to update `tracking.json`)
- Rebuild catalog, impact & README tables: `python3 tools/build_index.py`
- Verify schema, tracking proofs, hygiene, tokens, citations & fix commits (JSON): `python3 tools/validate.py --verify-upstream --format json`
- Run unit tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
